description: The ask operation §168.4 (DECISION-0165, DECISION-0399): run a registered case of a case package over its pinned dependencies and return the canonical evaluation document with a proof and a manifest. The question is JSON per query.schema.json (query), an evaluate string (evaluate + queryId), a saved queryId without query, or card + args. A refusal to prepare is an error with an LDC-* code, never an empty answer.

args.description: the card parameters: name → string expression of the language

card.description: the id of a card of an installed catalog DECISION-0190

case.description: the name of the case declaration from [[cases]]; optional when there is only one case

package.description: the path to the case package (the directory holding law.toml) from the root of the repository

query.description: the question as JSON per query.schema.json; queryId is a URN in the namespace of the package, or a short name given in queryId

queryId.description: without query/evaluate — the choice of a saved queries/*.json by short name or full URN; with evaluate — the id of the question being run

name: law_case_ask
